# e2ro
> e2ro provides AI-powered customer support automation and help desk tools for ecommerce and online businesses.

e2ro focuses on automating customer service workflows with AI agents, ticket handling, and integrations that help support teams respond faster and scale operations.

## Main Site
- [Home](https://e2ro.com/): Overview of e2ro’s AI customer support platform and core product capabilities.
- [Pricing](https://e2ro.com/pricing): Pricing plans and feature comparisons for different business sizes.
- [Contact](https://e2ro.com/contact): Contact options for sales, support, and general inquiries.
- [Book a Demo](https://e2ro.com/book-a-demo): Demo request page for evaluating the platform with the e2ro team.
- [About](https://e2ro.com/about): Company background, mission, and information about the team.

## Product
- [AI Customer Support](https://e2ro.com/ai-customer-support): Product page describing AI-driven support automation for customer conversations.
- [Help Desk](https://e2ro.com/help-desk): Overview of shared inbox and ticket management capabilities.
- [Automation](https://e2ro.com/automation): Workflow automation features for repetitive support tasks and routing.
- [Integrations](https://e2ro.com/integrations): Supported integrations with ecommerce, messaging, and support platforms.
- [Analytics](https://e2ro.com/analytics): Reporting and analytics features for support performance and operations.

## Solutions
- [Ecommerce Support](https://e2ro.com/solutions/ecommerce): Support automation use cases tailored for ecommerce businesses.
- [Shopify](https://e2ro.com/solutions/shopify): Product positioning and workflows for Shopify-based merchants.
- [Customer Service Teams](https://e2ro.com/solutions/customer-service): Solutions for internal support teams managing high ticket volumes.
- [Startups](https://e2ro.com/solutions/startups): Lightweight support automation for smaller and growing companies.
- [Enterprise](https://e2ro.com/solutions/enterprise): Scalable support operations and controls for larger organizations.
